_note: The market wall (James, 2026-11-01) replaces the leaving interstitial on /go/. Books are ordered: paying and eligible first, by `rank` (1 = the best affiliate terms, James's call, not by payout), unpaid books (Kalshi, the two Polymarkets, unregistered sportsbooks) last, also by rank. The top paying book carries the gold 'featured' pill. No age tick: the book checks age and location at sign-up; the fine print says so. Exceptions in market_wall.py: a visitor arriving from a page whose path names a book (kalshi, polymarket) sees that book first; a market no paying book carries shows its own book first. `pays` means the book runs an affiliate programme we can join without state registration; `affiliate_url` (a full tracking link) or `affiliate_id` + `tracking_param_name` turn a plain link into a paid one. `mirror: kalshi` means the book trades Kalshi's contracts, so a Kalshi market is the same market there (Robinhood, Coinbase). `link`: `ticker` = the market's own URL from board data; `alt` = the alternatives index's match on that venue; `hub` = the book's landing page (no deep link known). Switch the whole wall off with `enabled`, or per category / country with the `off_for_*` lists.
